    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    Arkanoid
    Main entry point for the Arkanoid game.
    BackToMenuButton
    Button that navigates back to the main menu when clicked.
    Ball
    The ball entity that bounces around the game field.
    Brick
    A single destructible brick that the ball can break.
    Button
    Abstract base class for all clickable text buttons in the game.
    ExtraLifePowerup
    Powerup that grants one extra life.
    FileManager
    Utility class for reading and writing simple key-value data to a flat file.
    FontManager
    Utility class for loading custom fonts used throughout the game.
    GameLevel
    The active gameplay scene containing the paddle, ball, bricks, and HUD.
    GameOverScene
    The end screen displayed after the game finishes (win or game over).
    GameText
    Abstract base class for HUD text elements displayed during gameplay.
    LevelSelector
    The level selector scene for choosing game difficulty or level.
    LivesText
    HUD label that displays the player's remaining lives in the top-right corner.
    MainMenu
    The main menu scene shown when the game starts.
    Paddle
    The player-controlled paddle at the bottom of the game field.
    Powerup
    Base class for falling powerups.
    QuitButton
    Button that exits the application when clicked.
    ScoreText
    HUD label that displays the player's current score in the top-left corner.
    SelectLevelButton
    Button that navigates to the level selector when clicked.
    StartButton
    Button that starts a new game when clicked.
    WiderPaddlePowerup
    Powerup that temporarily enlarges the paddle.
